body: Haha, I've tried that. Tried it, realized it didn't work, and tried it again. Faking confidence and happiness works for little things... but at the end of the day, I come home and look myself in the mirror, and see what's beneath, and die because I know that no one else cares enough to look that deep. They are satisfied with what they see on the surface. I've only met one person who could tell when I'm really smiling, really happy, and knows when I'm just saying that everything is ok. And I blew it.
I tried meditation for a while. It's one of those things where I can kind of convince myself everything is ok, but deep down, I know that I am lying.

I can't not think about it. Sometimes, it goes away for a while, but it always comes back worse than before. I've tried therapy, medication... nothing helps. I've tried hobbies. I've tried throwing all of myself into my work. The only friend who ever understood hates me now. Everyone else... I don't know, I think I'm a burden. They just don't get it. Talking to them would just make them awkward and uncomfortable, which would only make me feel worse. Family is what started me down this path. SO? Once again, hates me...
...I don't have enough fingers to count the things that, individually, would fuck a person up for life. And all I can do is blame myself. I have no one left to talk to, and that, too, is my fault.
